panel.plans.trafficHint: 0 = unlimited. When the quota is used up the subscription is suspended automatically and its sites stop.
panel.plans.validityHint: 0 = no expiry. The end date is calculated from this when the plan is assigned.
panel.alias.title: Domain aliases
panel.alias.hint: Serve the same site from a second domain name (e.g. example.com and example.co.uk).
panel.alias.redirectHint: Redirecting is recommended: serving the same content from two domains counts as duplicate content for search engines and weakens both.
panel.alias.noPrimary: This site has no main domain. Bind a domain first; without a redirect target an alias cannot redirect.
panel.alias.noHttpsHint: Visitors arriving on this alias get a certificate warning. Issue a certificate for this domain from the SSL tab.
alias.host_required: The domain name cannot be empty.
alias.same_as_primary: This is the site's own main domain; it cannot be added as an alias.
panel.mail.outboundLimitHint: Maximum messages per hour. A single compromised customer can get the server's IP blacklisted, and then nobody on that server gets mail delivered; this limit prevents that. 0 = unlimited.
panel.mail.outboundLimitNotConfiguredHin: There is NO outbound limit on the server for this domain. This is not the same as "unlimited": the panel could not set a limit.
mail.outbound_limit_saved: The outbound mail limit was saved.
mail.outbound_limit_failed: The outbound mail limit could not be applied.
mail.outbound_limit_unverified: The limit command reported success but could not be verified on the server; it is treated as not applied.
mail.outbound_limit_not_supported: The installed mail server does not support setting an outbound limit from the panel.
mail.queue_message_not_found: That message is not in the queue; it may already have been delivered or removed.
mail.queue_message_deleted: The message was removed from the queue.
mail.queue_delete_failed: The message could not be removed from the queue.
mail.queue_delete_unverified: The delete command reported success but the message is still queued; it is treated as not deleted.
mail.queue_not_supported: The installed mail server's queue cannot be managed from the panel.
mail.relay_saved: The outbound mail relay was saved and is now in use.
mail.relay_removed: The outbound mail relay was removed; delivery returns to direct routing.
mail.relay_host_required: The relay server address cannot be empty.
mail.relay_password_required: A password is required when a user name is given.
mail.relay_strategy_unavailable: The mail server's outbound routing settings could not be read.
mail.relay_failed: The outbound mail relay could not be applied.
mail.relay_unverified: The relay command reported success but could not be verified on the server; it is treated as not applied.
mail.relay_not_supported: The installed mail server does not support an outbound relay from the panel.
mail.client_settings_unavailable: Mail client settings could not be determined for this domain.
mail.domain_required: The domain name cannot be empty.
mail.autoconfig_published: Autoconfiguration published; Outlook and Thunderbird will fetch settings from the server.
mail.autoconfig_published_partial: Autoconfiguration was published but some steps are incomplete — see the status list for details.
mail.autoconfig_unpublished: Autoconfiguration removed; the rules and bindings the panel had written were deleted.
mail.autoconfig_site_not_found: No website serves this domain on 80/443, so there is no web root to publish autoconfiguration into.
panel.wpUpdates.title: Updates
panel.wpUpdates.hint: WordPress core, plugins and themes. Out-of-date plugins are a leading cause of compromised sites.
panel.wpUpdates.notMeasured: Update status COULD NOT be read. This does not mean everything is current — WordPress's database may be unreachable or wp-cli may have failed.
panel.wpUpdates.riskHint: Updates can break a site. Taking a backup first is recommended.
wp.updates_partial: Some items could not be updated; see the list for details.
panel.plans.editWarning: This plan may already be assigned to customers. Saving updates the limits of every subscription bound to it.
panel.sites.subdomainHint: A subdomain counts as a separate site and uses your site quota. If the parent domain's DNS zone is managed here, the A record is added automatically; otherwise you must create it at your DNS provider.
migration.site.partial: The migration finished only partially: some steps failed. The details below name the step that was skipped — complete it manually and run the migration again.
attention.action.missingEndpoint: This item has no one-click fix endpoint. You can fix it manually from the related screen.
panel.common.loadFailed: This section could not be read.
panel.files.confirmDeleteFolderMessage: The folder '{name}' and EVERY file and subfolder inside it will be permanently deleted. Nothing goes to the Recycle Bin.
panel.files.confirmDeleteFileMessage: The file '{name}' will be permanently deleted. It does not go to the Recycle Bin.
panel.ftp.confirmDeleteMessage: The FTP account '{name}' and its Windows user will be deleted. Clients using this account can no longer connect.
panel.plans.confirmDeleteMessage: The plan '{name}' will be deleted. Limits of subscriptions already bound to it are not updated with the plan; move those users to another plan first.
panel.account.confirmDisable2faMessage: Your account will be protected by the password alone. If you turn it back on you must set the authenticator app up again and take new recovery codes.
panel.proxy.confirmRemoveMessage: The reverse proxy of '{name}' will be removed; visitors can no longer reach the target application.
panel.protected.confirmRemoveMessage: The directory '{path}' becomes PUBLICLY accessible with no password prompt.
panel.alias.confirmRemoveMessage: The binding '{host}' will be deleted; visitors coming from that domain can no longer reach the site.
panel.subscription.confirmSuspendMessage: The user's sites will be stopped and visitors cannot reach them. Mail and databases are not deleted; 'Resume' brings everything back.
panel.subscription.readOnlyAction: Your subscription is suspended — the panel is read-only, so this action is unavailable.
panel.dns.confirmDnssecDisableMessage: The signature of the zone '{zone}' will be removed. Until the DS record is deleted from the parent zone, validating resolvers CANNOT resolve the domain — the site and mail may be temporarily unreachable.
panel.bulk.confirmDeleteMessage: The {count} selected items will be permanently deleted. Type the number of items to continue; the full list is below.
panel.bulk.deletedPartial: {done} of {total} items were deleted, {failed} COULD NOT be deleted:
panel.common.sectionChunkFailed: The files for this section could not be downloaded. If the panel was updated, the old page in your browser may be requesting files that no longer exist; reload the page.
panel.firewall.confirmBlockMessage: A rule that BLOCKS port {port}/{protocol} will be added to Windows Firewall. On Windows a block rule OVERRIDES an allow rule: everything connecting to this port (sites, e-mail, remote desktop, management tools) is cut off immediately.
panel.firewall.confirmBlockServerRefuses: The server will refuse this request — protected ports cannot be blocked from the panel.
panel.firewall.protectedReason.panel: WARNING: {port} is the PANEL'S OWN port. Blocking it locks you out of the management panel for good and cannot be undone from the panel.
panel.firewall.protectedReason.rdp: WARNING: 3389 is the remote desktop port. Blocking it also closes the last remote way into the server.
panel.firewall.protectedReason.web: WARNING: {port} is a web port. Blocking it makes EVERY site on this server unreachable at once.
panel.files.bulkFolderWarn: The selection contains {count} folders: folders are deleted with EVERYTHING inside them.
panel.mail.confirmBulkDelete: The {count} selected mailboxes and ALL messages inside them will be permanently deleted. Type the number of mailboxes to continue.
panel.mail.queueHint: Messages waiting to be delivered. When mail "doesn't go out", start here: which message is stuck, which recipient failed, and when the next attempt is due.
panel.mail.queueUnavailable: Could not reach the mail server; the queue cannot be read. This does NOT mean the queue is empty.
panel.mail.queueEmpty: No messages are waiting in the queue.
panel.mail.queueNoRecipients: This message has no recipient records.
panel.mail.queueDeleteTitle: Remove the message from the queue?
panel.mail.queueDeleteConfirm: This message will be discarded WITHOUT delivery and cannot be restored. The sender will not be told it never arrived.
panel.mail.relayHint: Most providers block outbound port 25, and mail then never leaves the server. Route outgoing mail through a relay (SendGrid, Mailgun, your provider's SMTP).
panel.mail.relayUnavailable: Could not reach the mail server; the relay settings could not be read. An empty form here does NOT reflect the current configuration.
panel.mail.relayEnabled: Send outgoing mail through a relay
panel.mail.relayPortTlsHint: Direct TLS usually uses port 465; 587 is for STARTTLS.
panel.mail.relayUsernameHint: Leave empty to connect without authentication.
panel.mail.relayPasswordKeep: Leave empty to keep the stored password. For security the password is never shown back.
panel.mail.relayPasswordHint: A password is required if you provide a user name.
panel.mail.relayAllowInvalidCerts: Do not verify the relay certificate
panel.mail.relayAllowInvalidCertsWarn: With certificate verification off the connection can be intercepted; use this only for relays on your internal network.
panel.mail.relayDisabledHint: With the relay off, mail is delivered directly to recipient servers over MX.
panel.mail.relayImpactRemoved: The relay definition will be removed and delivery returns to direct routing.
panel.mail.relayImpactPasswordCleared: The relay password stored in the panel will be deleted as well.
panel.mail.relayConfirmSave: From now on ALL mail leaving this server is handed to the relay below. If the settings are wrong, mail silently piles up.
panel.mail.relayConfirmRemove: Once the relay is removed, mail is delivered directly again. If your provider blocks outbound port 25, outgoing mail will NOT be delivered at all.
panel.mail.clientSettingsNone: The server reported no client connection points for this domain.
panel.mail.autoconfig.title: Mail client autoconfiguration
panel.mail.autoconfig.subtitle: Let Outlook and Thunderbird fill in server and port settings by themselves.
panel.mail.autoconfig.requiredDns: Records you must create at your DNS provider
panel.dns.confirmBulkDelete: The {count} selected DNS records will be removed from the zone. Deleting records such as A or MX can make the site and mail unreachable from the outside. Type the number of records to continue.
panel.dns.bulkManagedWarn: The selection contains {count} panel-MANAGED records; those can be brought back with “Restore defaults”.
panel.sites.noToolsForRole: There is no tool available to your role on this tab.
panel.license.title: License
panel.license.subtitle: Panel license status and activation
panel.license.removeConfirm: The license key will be deleted from this installation. Your sites, mail and databases keep running; only creating new resources is disabled. Continue?
panel.license.fingerprintHint: This is the only machine information sent to the license server; it is an irreversible hash.
panel.license.notConfiguredHint: No verification address is configured, so the panel sends no requests anywhere and nothing is restricted.
panel.license.restrictedHint: Your existing sites, mailboxes and databases keep running. You can still back up, restore and access your files.
panel.license.fingerprintSourceWarning: The fingerprint was derived from the panel data folder only (the hardware identifier could not be read). If that folder is moved or reinstalled the fingerprint changes and the license may need to be activated again.
reseller.site_quota_exceeded: Reseller site limit exceeded: the total number of sites allocated to your customers exceeds your own limit. Contact your administrator to raise it.
reseller.disk_quota_exceeded: Reseller disk limit exceeded: the total disk space allocated to your customers exceeds your own limit. Contact your administrator to raise it.
license.not_configured: Licensing is not configured on this installation.
license.invalid: The license key is invalid. Creating new resources is disabled; your existing sites, mail and databases keep running.
license.subscription_limit: You have reached the number of subscriptions your license allows.
license.missing: No license key entered. Activate your license to create new resources.
license.expired: The license has expired. Creating new resources is disabled; your existing sites, mail and databases keep running.
license.grace: The license server is unreachable. The panel keeps working normally during the offline grace period.
license.offline_grace_expired: The license server stayed unreachable for the whole offline grace period. Creating new resources is disabled; your existing sites, mail and databases keep running.
panel.running.hint: The operation is running on the server. Keep this tab open: if you close it the job keeps running on the server, but you will not see its result or duration here.
panel.backup.searchPlaceholder: Search by backup name, site, customer, status or path
panel.backup.emptyFiltered: No backup matches this search. Your backups are still there; only the filter did not match.
panel.backup.location.unknown: The record carries no local path.
panel.backup.location.remoteHidden: The remote address could not be parsed; an address whose contents we cannot verify is not printed on screen.
panel.backup.location.remoteMasked: The credential/signature part of the remote address is HIDDEN (e.g. the query string of an S3 presigned URL). What is shown is enough to locate the target; the signature is an authorisation a screenshot would hand over.
panel.backup.location.existenceUnknown: The panel does NOT verify that this file is still on disk: the path comes from the record. If the file was deleted by hand the path is still shown.
panel.backup.location.rootHint: Day folders (YYYY-MM-DD) are created under this root, each containing sites / databases / mail / panel / subscriptions folders.
panel.dns.zoneTypeHint: The panel manages the records of a primary zone. In a secondary (slave) zone the records arrive from an external master DNS server via zone transfer (AXFR); the panel only serves the copy.
panel.dns.masterServersHelp: One IP per line (IPv4 or IPv6). The zone is pulled from these servers. At least one IP is required: a secondary zone without a master never receives data and the domain does not resolve.
panel.dns.secondaryActiveHint: The zone is secondary; records are pulled from these master servers: {masters}. Record changes are made on the master.
panel.dns.effectiveNotifyHint: Allowed to pull the zone (AXFR): {list}. Server-wide secondary DNS servers are included in this list.
panel.dns.secondaryRecordsReadOnly: This zone is secondary (slave). The list below shows the records the panel STORES; the published content comes from the master server. Switching back to primary republishes these records.
panel.dns.secondaryEnabledMsg: The zone is now secondary (slave) and a transfer from the master was started.
panel.dns.primaryRestoredMsg: The zone was switched back to primary; the panel's records were republished.
panel.dns.transferStartedMsg: A full zone transfer (AXFR) from the master was started.
panel.dns.confirmSecondaryMessage: The authoritative source of the zone '{zone}' moves from this server to the master DNS server. The panel's records are not deleted but they STOP BEING PUBLISHED: if a record is missing on the master (an MX, for example), mail for that domain stops immediately. Type the zone name to continue.
panel.dns.confirmPrimaryTitle: Switch the zone back to primary?
panel.dns.confirmPrimaryMessage: The zone '{zone}' will be managed by the panel again and the records it stores will be published. Content pulled from the master will no longer be updated on this server.
panel.dnsTemplate.secondaryServersHelp: One IP per line. These servers may pull (AXFR) EVERY zone for which the panel is primary and receive NOTIFY when a zone changes. You no longer have to enter the IP zone by zone — and a forgotten zone means that domain is never copied to the backup DNS.
dns.secondary_enabled: The zone is now secondary (slave); a transfer from the master was started.
dns.primary_restored: The zone was switched back to primary and its records were republished.
dns.secondary_zone_active: The zone is secondary (slave): records are pulled from the master DNS server.
dns.zone_type_mismatch: The panel's record and the zone type in Windows DNS DO NOT MATCH. Re-apply the zone type; otherwise record changes never reach the published zone.
dns.zone_is_secondary: The zone is secondary (slave); its records come from the master DNS server and cannot be changed from the panel. Make the change on the master or switch the zone back to primary.
dns.master_required: Enter at least one master DNS server IP for a secondary zone.
dns.invalid_master_ip: The master DNS server IP address is invalid.
dns.invalid_secondary_ip: The secondary DNS server IP address is invalid.
dns.secondary_apply_failed: The secondary (slave) zone could not be configured on Windows DNS Server.
dns.transfer_requires_secondary: A zone transfer can only be started for secondary (slave) zones.
dns.transfer_requires_windows: A zone transfer requires the Windows DNS Server role.
dns.transfer_failed: The zone transfer from the master could not be started.
